3| // quarantine routes batches that fail strict parsing into the
4| // quarantine lane instead of dropping them: malformed telemetry is
5| // usually a producer bug, and the payload is the evidence. The lane
6| // is accounted per tenant, and the per-tenant cap comes from

9| func (g *Gateway) quarantine(tenant string, batch []byte, code rejectCode) error {
10| 	if !g.lanes.admit(tenant) {
11| 		g.metrics.quarantineOverflow.Inc()
12| 		return g.overflow(tenant, batch, code)

19| // make room, on the theory that the newest failure carries the
20| // freshest evidence about the producer bug.
21| func (g *Gateway) overflow(tenant string, batch []byte, code rejectCode) error {
22| 	oldest, err := g.lanes.evictOldest(tenant)
23| 	if err != nil {
24| 		return err
25| 	}
26| 	g.park(oldest)
27| 	return g.lanes.hold(tenant, batch, code)
